newsitem.title: LEBANON: BEIRUT BANK TRADES AT ALLTIME HIGH.
newsitem.headline: BEIRUT BANK TRADES AT ALLTIME HIGH.

text.p: Banque Libanaise pour Le Commerce rose to an alltime high of $17.5 on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Tuesday and brokers said the stock was set to rise further.
"A lot of people are finding the share a good buy at $17.5. If logic should prevail, the share is set to rise further," Alain Balian, Deputy Manager at Beirut finance house Lebanon Invest said.
He said last week's jump of Banque Audi shares to $23 stimulated the rise in BLC, which first traded on the exchange last December at $11.25.

"If you go by price/earnings ratio, BLC has the lowest on the market at below 10 while the two other banks are around 12 or 13 plus, which means that BLC has more catching up to do," Balian told Reuters.
"Institutional investors are becoming more interested in the share because they are seeing that the bank is really profitable," he added.
Banque Audi fell for the second day to $22.25 from $22.5 in profit-taking while Bank of Beirut was unchanged at $3.625. All banks traded in heavy demand.
Bank shares were also traded in blocks. Two blocks totalling 20,000 BLC shares were traded on the floor at $17.25 and $17.375. Also traded were two blocs of 25,000 BOB shares at $3.5625 and $3.625.

"The Banking sector will continue to be the dominant investment vehicle for the coming couple of years. It is the most transparent sector and the only investment alternative to real estate sector," he added.
Solidere shares were mixed with A shares trading at $10.5 from $10.25 while B shares traded at $10.75 from $11. Demand for both A and B shares exceeded supply.
"Technically, Solidere is a good buy at these prices because the company earnings are high and thus justify higher prices," Balian said.
The LIBX bank index rose 0.11 percent to 146.05. The BLOM general index rose 0.49 to 924.34 while the LISPI general index fell 0.26 percent 88.07.
Of the four listed industrial firms, pipemaker Eternit fell to $1.875 from $1.9375 while Ciments Libanais was unchanged at $1.28125.
There was no trade in either Ciment Blancs or Uniceramic.
Total BSE turnover was 200,550 shares for a value of $2,129,428 compared with 246,796 shares for $2,696,513 a day earlier.
